z-m-01-07.title: Idan aka ƙara, shin kullum adadin zai fi na farko?
z-m-01-07.goal: Koyi cewa domin yanke hukunci kan ikirari ana buƙatar sanin 'adadin da aka ƙara', ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa ta ƙara 0, sannan ka gyara ikirarin tare da sharadinsa.
z-m-01-07.material: Akwai marmara 5 a akwatin marmara. Jian ya ce, "Idan ka ƙara marmara a akwatin, kullum marmara za su fi adadin farko!" (Ba a cire marmara daga akwatin; ana saka su ne kawai.)
z-m-01-07.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar bayanin da ake buƙata domin yanke hukunci
z-m-01-07.prereq.0: Kwarewar ƙirga da haɗa lambobi har zuwa 10, da sanin cewa 0 yana nufin 'babu ko kaɗan'
z-m-01-07.s.s1.prompt: Jian ya ce, 'Idan aka ƙara marmara a akwatin, kullum za su fi adadin farko.' Wane ƙarin bayani kake buƙata domin sanin ko wannan daidai ne?
z-m-01-07.s.s1.hint.0: Da marmara 5 a akwatin, ka yi tunanin yanayin saka marmara 1 da na saka marmara 3.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.hint.1: Canza adadin marmarar da ka saka ta hanyoyi daban-daban, sannan nemo adadin da ke sa ikirarin ya zama ba daidai ba.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da yake shakkar ko sakamakon ya danganta da adadin da aka saka.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.b: Launi ba shi da alaƙa da samun marmara da yawa ko kaɗan. Kana buƙatar nemo bayanin da ya shafi adadin marmara.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.c: Ko akwatin babba ne ko ƙarami, ana iya ƙirga adadin marmara da ke ciki dabam. Wannan bayanin ba shi da alaƙa da ko adadin zai ƙaru.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.explain: Kalmomin 'ƙara wasu' ba su faɗi adadin da aka saka ba. Kana buƙatar sanin adadin da aka ƙara domin yanke hukunci ko sun fi na farko.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi adadin marmara na farko da adadin da aka saka, sannan ƙirƙiri yanayi 2 masu adadin farko daban-daban inda marmara ba su fi na farko ba. (Marmarar farko aƙalla 1 ce kuma ba ta wuce 20 ba.)
z-m-01-07.s.s2.hint.0: Canza adadin marmarar da aka saka sannan rubuta ko sun fi adadin farko.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wane adadin da aka saka zai bar marmarar akwatin ba tare da canji ba.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.var.b: Adadin marmara da aka ƙara (0 ko fiye)
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Marmaran farko 1 ko fiye ne, kuma bai wuce 20 ba.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta adadin marmaran farko a matsayin lambar halitta daga 1 zuwa 20.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Adadin marmaran da aka ƙara 0 ko fiye ne.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Rubuta adadin marmaran da aka ƙara a matsayin lambar halitta 0 ko fiye.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Marmaran ba su fi na farko yawa ba. Ikirarin Jian ya karye.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Marmaran sun fi na farko yawa. Sake zaɓar adadin da aka ƙara.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.explain: Idan aka ƙara marmara 0, marmaran suna nan yadda suke. Wannan gaskiya ce ko mene ne adadin farko. Saboda haka ikirarin “idan ka ƙara, kullum za su ƙaru” yana buƙatar sharadin “idan ka ƙara ko da 1 ne”.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta ikirarin Jian yadda ya kamata. Rubuta lokacin da marmaran suka fi adadin farko da lokacin da ba haka ba.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.hint.0: A misalan da ka ƙirƙira a sama, nawa aka ƙara? Faɗi abin da ya faru da marmaran a lokacin.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.hint.1: Sanya yanayin ƙara marmara 1 da yanayin ƙara 0 gefe da gefe, sannan ka rubuta jumla guda.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Gyaran ikirarina yana bayyana duka yanayin ƙara 0 da ƙara 1 ko fiye?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ya ce haka ne ko mene ne adadin marmaran farko?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.model.0: Idan aka ƙara 1 ko fiye, adadin ya fi na farko. Amma idan aka ƙara 0, ya kasance iri ɗaya.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.model.1: Idan ba a ƙara komai ba, ba ya ƙaruwa, ya kasance yadda yake tun farko. Idan an ƙara ko da guda ɗaya ne, adadin yana ƙaruwa.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa mai bayyana ma’ana iri ɗaya ba tare da kalmar “0” ba.

z-m-01-03.thinking.1: Nemo sharuɗɗan da magana ke aiki a kansu
z-m-01-03.title: Shin musanya jeri yana ba da ƙima iri ɗaya?
z-m-01-03.topic: Musanya jeri a tarawa da ragewa
z-m-01-03.goal: Yayin da ake samun sabon bayani kaɗan-kaɗan, rage zangon da ikirarin “musanya jeri yana ba da ƙima ɗaya” yake daidai, sannan ka nemo yanayin da ba za a iya musanya jeri ba.
z-m-01-03.material: Seoyun tana magana game da alewa ta ce, “Idan ka lissafta da lambobi biyu, za ka samu ƙima iri ɗaya ko da ka musanya jeri.” Mu duba bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, mu yi tunanin har zuwa ina ikirarin Seoyun yake daidai. Ba za a iya raba alewa ko ƙirƙiro ta daga babu ba, kuma ba za ka iya cin fiye da abin da kake da shi ba.
z-m-01-03.thinking.0: Gyara zangon hukunci idan sabon bayani ya zo
z-m-01-03.thinking.2: Bincika ko ana iya yin lissafi bayan musanya jeri
z-m-01-03.prereq.0: Kwarewar bayyana haɗawa da ɗauke abu da lambobi har zuwa 10
z-m-01-03.s.s1.prompt: Duba bayanai mataki-mataki, ka ga yadda tunaninka game da ikirarin Seoyun yake canzawa.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo abu guda da ya bambanta a sabon bayani idan aka kwatanta da farko.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faɗi a waɗanne yanayi ikirarin Seoyun daidai ne, kuma a waɗanne ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Haɗa faranti mai alewa 3 da faranti mai alewa 5. 3 da 5 idan aka haɗa su suna zama 8. Idan ka musanya jeri ka haɗa 5 da 3, su ma 8 ne. Seoyun ta ce, “Idan ka lissafta da lambobi biyu, za ka samu ƙima iri ɗaya ko da ka musanya jeri.”
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Bisa abin da ka gani zuwa yanzu, me kake tunani game da ikirarin Seoyun?
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Abin da muka gani har yanzu shi ne haɗawa kawai, don haka ra’ayi mai taka-tsantsan kamar a ko b ya dace. c ya yi ƙaƙƙarfan magana game da yanayin da ba mu gani ba.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Da alama haka yake wajen haɗawa, amma muna buƙatar duba wasu yanayi kuma.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya bambanta yanayin da muka gani (haɗawa) da waɗanda ba mu gani ba tukuna.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Akwai misalai biyu ne kawai, don haka ba za mu iya tabbatarwa ko da ga haɗawa ba.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci yana taka-tsantsan saboda misalai kaɗan ne. Ra’ayin shi ne a bincika da ƙarin misalai.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: A yarda cewa yana daidai koyaushe ga kowane lissafi da lambobi biyu.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ya faɗaɗa misalan haɗawa zuwa kowane lissafi. Ba mu duba lissafin ragewa ko neman abin da ya rage ba tukuna.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Mun ƙara duba misalan haɗawa. 4 da 6 suna zama 10, haka ma 6 da 4 suna zama 10. 0 da 7 suna zama 7, haka ma 7 da 0 suna zama 7. Yanzu ka yi tunanin cin alewa 4 daga cikin alewa 9: alewa 5 za su rage. Idan aka musanya jeri, “cin alewa 9 daga alewa 4” ba zai yiwu ba, don haka wannan lissafi zai buƙaci wata hanyar da ba mu koya ba tukuna.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bisa abin da ka gani yanzu, me kake tunani game da ikirarin Seoyun?
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Misalan haɗawa sun ci gaba da zama daidai, yanayin da ba za a iya musanya jeri ba kuma ya bayyana ne kawai wajen cin alewa. Hukuncin da yake ware zangon da ikirarin yake daidai ya fi dacewa.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Idan ana haɗawa daidai ne, amma wajen cin alewa akwai lokutan da ba za a musanya jeri ba.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka raba yanayin haɗawa da cin alewa, sannan ka takaita zangon da ikirarin yake daidai.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ko ana haɗawa ko cin alewa, ƙimar koyaushe iri ɗaya ce idan an musanya jeri.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: A yanayin cin alewa, an samu yanayi inda musanya jeri yake sa lissafin ba zai yiwu ba. Sake bincika ko wannan ya dace da misalin.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Misalin cin alewa ba daidai ba ne, saboda haka ba za mu iya amincewa da yanayin haɗawa ma ba yanzu.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Misalin cin alewa ba ya karya yanayin haɗawa. Duk nau’i-nau’i uku na misalan haɗawa sun ba da ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Mu gyara ikirarin Seoyun ta ƙara sharadi. Cikin yanayin cin alewa, idan ka ci alewa 5 daga cikin 5, 0 ne zai rage. A wannan yanayin, ko an musanya jeri lissafin iri ɗaya ne, don haka sakamakon 0 ne. Amma akwai yanayin da ba za a iya musanya jeri ba, kamar cin 4 daga cikin alewa 9.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zaɓi hanya mafi dacewa ta gyara ikirarin Seoyun.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Takaita zangon kamar a ko ware yanayi dabam-dabam kamar d duk hanyoyi ne masu kyau na gyara ikirarin Seoyun.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Idan ka haɗa lambobi biyu, ƙimar iri ɗaya ce ko da ka musanya jeri.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan magana ta takaita ga yanayin da ikirarin yake daidai (haɗawa).
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ga lissafin lambobi biyu, ko haɗawa ne ko cin alewa, ƙimar koyaushe iri ɗaya ce idan ka musanya jeri.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan magana ta faɗaɗa zuwa kowane lissafi duk da cewa an samu misalin cin alewa inda ba za a iya musanya jeri ba.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Idan ka fara rubuta babbar lamba, kowane lissafi yana ba da ƙima iri ɗaya idan an musanya jeri.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan ka fara da babbar lamba, akwai lissafin da ba za a iya yi ba bayan musanya jeri. Wannan batun ya bambanta da ko musanya jeri yana ba da ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Idan an haɗa su, iri ɗaya ne; amma idan ana ci, akwai lokutan da bai kamata a juya jeri ba.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan magana tana rarrabe yanayin haɗawa da yanayin ci.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.reflect: Bayanin farko ya shafi haɗawa kawai, saboda haka ba za mu iya sanin zangon da ikirarin yake daidai ba. Yayin da sabon bayani ya zo, ka fara rarrabe yanayin da yake daidai da wanda ba daidai ba?
z-m-01-03.s.s2.prompt: Ga lambobi a da b daga 0 zuwa 20, nemo yanayi 2 daban-daban da za a iya yin duka 'cire b daga a' da 'cire a daga b'. (Idan abin da kake son cirewa ya fi abin da kake da shi yawa, ba za a iya yi ba.)
z-m-01-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi a da b, karanta lissafin biyun da baki, sannan ka duba ko za a iya yin kowanne.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta wanne lissafi ba za a iya yi ba idan a ya fi b da kuma idan a ya yi ƙasa da b.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta lambobin biyun a matsayin natural numbers daga 0 zuwa 20.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Za a iya cire b daga a.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Domin cire b daga a, dole a kada ya yi ƙasa da b.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Za a iya cire a daga b ma.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ba za a iya cire a daga b ba. b ya yi ƙasa da a.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.explain: Sai dai idan lambar da kake son cirewa da wadda kake da ita sun yi daidai ne kawai za a iya yi bayan musanya jeri, sakamakon kuma zai zama 0. Dole ne ka fara bincika ko za a iya yin lissafin bayan musanya jeri.

z-m-01-01.title: Hanyoyin raba marmara 9 tsakanin jaka biyu
z-m-01-01.topic: Rarrabawa da haɗa lambobi har zuwa 10
z-m-01-01.goal: Nuna ta ƙirƙira da kanka cewa akwai hanyoyi da yawa na raba 9 zuwa lambobi biyu, sannan ka bayyana yadda za a ƙirga su ba tare da barin ko maimaita ɗaya ba.
z-m-01-01.material: Akwai marmara 9. Kana son saka dukkan su cikin jaka biyu, ja da shuɗi, ba tare da saura ba. Kowace jaka za ta samu aƙalla marmara 1. Jikunansu launuka dabam-dabam ne, don haka za ka iya bambance su. Mina ta ce, “Hanya ɗaya ce kawai ta raba marmara 9 tsakanin jaka biyu.”
z-m-01-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar hanyoyi da yawa da suka cika sharuɗɗa
z-m-01-01.thinking.2: Bayyana yadda za a ƙirga ba tare da barin ko maimaita komai ba
z-m-01-01.prereq.0: Kwarewar rarraba da haɗa lambobi har zuwa 10 (matakin aji na 1)
z-m-01-01.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce mai kyau ta gano ko Mina tana da gaskiya?
z-m-01-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka faɗi adadin marmaran da za su rage wa jaka shuɗi idan ka saka marmara 1 a jaka ja.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.hint.1: Canza adadin marmara a jaka ja zuwa 2, sannan 3, ka ga abin da ya faru da adadin da ya rage.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.a: Tuni an ƙayyade cewa marmara 9 ne. Abin da kake son ganowa shi ne yawan hanyoyin raba su.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.o.b: Akwai jaka biyu, saboda haka ina tsammani hanya guda ce kawai.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ya ɗauki adadin jaka da adadin hanyoyin raba marmara a matsayin abu ɗaya. Bai duba abin da ke faruwa idan adadin da aka saka ya canza ba.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.o.c: Canza adadin marmara da aka saka a jaka ja.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne na gwada kai tsaye ko akwai wasu hanyoyi ta canza yadda ake rabawa.
z-m-01-01.s.s1.explain: Ikirarin “hanya ɗaya kawai” yana karyewa da zarar wata hanya guda ta bayyana. Gwada ko canza adadin marmara a jaka ja ma yana canza adadin da ya rage wa jaka shuɗi.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Raba duk marmara 9 ta yadda jaka ja ta fi jaka shuɗi. Ƙirƙiri hanyoyi 3 dabam-dabam. Kowace jaka ta samu aƙalla 1.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi adadi ga jaka ja, sannan ka ƙirga abin da ya rage wa jaka shuɗi.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi lambobi yayin da kake kwatanta ko adadin jaka ja ya fi na jaka shuɗi.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Adadin marmara lamba ce ta halitta, aƙalla 1. Saka aƙalla marmara 1 a kowace jaka.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne marmaran cikin jakunkunan biyu su haɗu su zama 9.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Jaka ja dole ne ta ƙunshi marmara fiye da jaka shuɗi.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.explain: Saka marmara 5, 6, 7, ko 8 a jaka ja yana ba da hanyoyi 4 duka masu yiwuwa. Da zarar an ƙayyade adadin jaka ja, an ƙayyade na jaka shuɗi ma; saboda haka adadi dabam a jaka ja yana nufin wata hanya dabam.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.prompt: Idan ka bambance jakunkunan bisa launi, hanyoyi nawa ne gaba ɗaya na raba marmara 9 tsakanin jakunkunan biyu? Ka kuma rubuta yadda ka ƙirga ba tare da barin ko maimaita wata hanya ba.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ka ƙayyade adadin jaka ja. To, nawa ne zai rage wa jaka shuɗi?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.hint.1: Fara da 1 a jaka ja, sannan ka ƙara ɗaya-ɗaya; rubuta a jadawali ko a matsayin jimlolin lissafi, ka tabbatar ka kai ƙarshe.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Adadin hanyoyin da na ƙirga ya yi daidai da adadin hanyoyin da na jera?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka duba cewa ba ka ƙirga hanya ɗaya sau biyu ko ka bar wata ba?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka lura cewa amsar tana canzawa dangane da ko ka bambance jakunkunan ta launi?
z-m-01-01.s.s3.model.0: Na saka marmara 1, 2, 3, ... 8 a jaka ja a jere, na rubuta abin da ya rage wa jaka shuɗi. 1+8, 2+7, ... 8+1 ne, don haka hanyoyi 8 ne gaba ɗaya. Idan launukan sun bambanta, 5+4 da 4+5 hanyoyi dabam-dabam ne.
z-m-01-01.s.s3.model.1: Idan na ƙara adadin jaka ja ɗaya bayan ɗaya, 1, 2, 3, ... 8, jaka shuɗi tana da 8, 7, ... 1. 5+4 da 4+5 ma hanyoyi dabam-dabam ne saboda launukan sun bambanta, saboda haka hanyoyi 8 ne gaba ɗaya.

z-m-01-06.title: Shin jumlar lissafi ɗaya za ta iya dacewa da labarai da yawa?
z-m-01-06.goal: Koyi cewa jumlar lissafi ɗaya na iya bayyana a cikin labarai daban-daban (abin da ya rage, bambanci), sannan da kanka ka ƙirƙiri labarin da ya dace da jumlar lissafi da aka bayar.
z-m-01-06.material: Jumlar lissafi 12-5 ba sai ta dace da labari guda ɗaya kawai ba. Duba abin da 12 da 5 suke nufi a kowane labari da abin da ake tambayar a nemo, sannan ka zaɓi labaran da suka dace da jumlar. Ba a raba abubuwa ko ƙirƙirar su daga babu.
z-m-01-06.thinking.1: Nemo labarai da yawa da ke nuna jumlar lissafi iri ɗaya
z-m-01-06.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar labari da ya dace da jumlar lissafi
z-m-01-06.prereq.0: Kwarewar ƙirga lambobi har zuwa 20 da karanta labaran ƙari da cirewa
z-m-01-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk labaran da suka dace da jumlar lissafi 12-5. (Ana karanta 12-5 'sha biyu cire biyar'.)
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane labari, rubuta abin da 12 da 5 suke nufi.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko abin da labarin yake nema shi ne 'lamba mafi girma da 12' ko 'lamba ƙarama da 12'.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.a: Yaro yana da fensir 12, ya sayi ƙarin fensir 5 a shagon kayan rubutu. Fensir nawa ne gaba ɗaya?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka haɗa labarin da abubuwa ke ƙaruwa da jumlar lissafi 12-5. Sake rubuta jumlar lissafin da ta dace da labarin.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.b: Balloon 5 cikin 12 sun fashe. Balloon nawa suka rage?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka haɗa labarin da aka cire 5 daga 12 da jumlar lissafi.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.c: Bayan an ci apple 5, apple 7 suka rage a faranti. Apple nawa ne tun farko?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.c: Jumlar lissafi ba 12-5 ba ce, sai dai '□-5=7'. Labarin da yake tambayar adadin farko yana amfani da wata jumlar lissafi dabam.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.o.d: Akwai ƙwallaye ja 12 da shuɗi 5. Ja nawa suka fi shuɗi?
z-m-01-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka koya cewa labarin kwatanta lambobi biyu domin nemo bambanci ma ana iya nuna shi da 12-5.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.explain: Labarin balloon yana tambayar adadin da ya rage bayan an cire 5 daga 12, labarin ƙwallaye kuma yana tambayar bambancin 12 da 5. Dukkansu ana iya nuna su da 12-5. Labarin fensir yana da 12+5, na apple kuma □-5=7.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.prompt: Da kanka ƙirƙiri labarin da ya dace da jumlar lissafi 9+6. Rubuta shi domin ya nuna abin da 9 da 6 suke nufi a labarin da abin da ake tambaya. ('9+6' ana karantawa 'tara ƙari shida'.)
z-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke shawarar abin da 9 da 6 kowannensu yake ƙirgawa.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yanayi guda inda aka haɗa lambobi biyu, sannan rubuta abin da kake son tambaya a wannan yanayi a matsayin tambaya ɗaya.
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A bayyane yake abin da 9 da 6 suke nufi a labarina?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Amsar tambayar lamba ce da ake samu da 9+6?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Labarin ne da zai sa aboki ya tuna da 9+6 idan ya karanta shi?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.model.0: Akwai apple 9 a kwando, Mama ta saka ƙarin 6. Apple nawa ne gaba ɗaya?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.model.1: Akwai yara 9 a filin wasa, ƙarin 6 suka zo. Yara nawa ne a filin wasan yanzu?
z-m-01-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta mayar da yanayin haɗawa zuwa labarin da adadi ke ƙaruwa. Labarin da ya haɗa rukunoni biyu daban ma ya dace.

z-m-01-08.thinking.1: Nemo layin farko da ke da kuskure a mafita.
z-m-01-08.title: Lambar da ke cikin □: ta yaya za mu amince da ita?
z-m-01-08.goal: Koyi cewa za a iya bincika ƙimomin □ da aka samu ta hanyoyi dabam-dabam da ma’auni ɗaya: saka lambar da aka samu, sannan nemo mafita mai kuskure ka bayyana wa aboki yadda zai bincika.
z-m-01-08.material: A cikin jumlar lissafi □+6=14, □ ita ce “lambar da za ta samar da 14 idan aka ƙara 6”. Dohyeon ya samo ta ta gwada lambobi a □ ɗaya bayan ɗaya, Sea kuma ta ƙirga baya matakai 6 daga 14. Gaon ya warware ta ta wata hanya. (“□+6=14” ana karanta ta “akwati da ƙari shida daidai yake da goma sha huɗu”.)
z-m-01-08.thinking.0: Bincika hanyoyi dabam-dabam da ma’auni ɗaya
z-m-01-08.prereq.0: Kwarewar nemo jimillar lambobi har zuwa 20 da kuma nemo lambar da idan aka ƙara da wani adadi za ta samar da wata ƙima
z-m-01-08.s.s1.prompt: A cikin □+6=14, Dohyeon ya gwada 7, 9, da 8 a □ a jere, ya sami 8. Sea ta ƙirga baya matakai 6 daga 14, ta sami 8. Wane abu ne daidai game da hanyoyin biyu?
z-m-01-08.s.s1.hint.0: Bincika ko lambobin da su biyun suka samu iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.hint.1: Saka lambar da ka samu, 8, a cikin □, ka lissafta 8+6, sannan ka duba ko ya zama 14.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.a: Hanyar Dohyeon ta gwada lambobi kai tsaye kaɗai ce za a iya amincewa da ita.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ra’ayi ya amince da hanyar gwada lambobi kai tsaye kawai. Hanyar Sea ma ta ba da lamba iri ɗaya, kuma ana iya bincika ta ta saka lambar.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.b: Hanyar Sea ta ƙirga baya ce kaɗai daidai.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ra’ayi ya karɓi hanyar ƙirga baya kawai. An kuma bincika hanyar Dohyeon ta saka lamba a □.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.c: Ga hanyoyin biyu, za a iya bincika ta saka 8 a cikin □.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya lura cewa ana iya bincika hanyoyin biyu da ma’auni ɗaya (ko saka lambar a □ yana samar da 14).
z-m-01-08.s.s1.o.d: Hanyar Sea da ta samo amsar da sauri ita ce hanya madaidaiciya.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.r.d: Nemo da sauri ba shi da alaƙa da kasancewa daidai. Ma’aunin shi ne ko lambar da ka samo tana samar da 14 idan aka saka ta a □.
z-m-01-08.s.s1.explain: Gwada lambobi da ƙirga baya hanyoyi dabam-dabam ne, amma sun samo lamba ɗaya, 8. Ko wace hanya ka yi amfani da ita, za ka iya amincewa da lambar idan ka saka ta a □ ka tabbatar cewa 8+6=14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.prompt: Gaon ya nemo □ a cikin □+6=14 kamar haka. Zaɓi layi guda da yake da wuya a yarda da shi.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka yi hasashen ko □ wataƙila lamba ce da ta fi 14 girma ko ƙasa da 14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.hint.1: Karanta kowanne layi na mafitar a jere, sannan ka kwatanta da abin da ka yi hasashe a baya.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.line.0: Ya ce idan aka ƙara 6 ga □, ana samun 14.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.line.1: Saboda haka ya haɗa 14 da 6 domin nemo □.
z-m-01-08.s.s2.explain: Matsalar farko tana layi na 2. Idan ƙara 6 ga □ ya ba da 14, to ƙara wani 6 ga 14 zai ba da lambar da ta fi □ girma. Saboda haka □=20 na layi na 4 ma yana da wuya a yarda da shi. Abin da ka lura da shi ya danganta da layin da ka zaɓa. Layi na 1 daidai ne domin ya mayar da jumlar lissafi zuwa kalmomi.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta wa Gaon da kalmomi yadda zai iya bincika da kansa ko □=20 daidai ne.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.hint.0: Saka 20 da Gaon ya samo a madadin □, sannan ka lissafta gefen hagu.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.hint.1: Saka sakamakon lissafinka kusa da 14 a gefen dama, ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai, sannan ka gaya wa Gaon.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta matakai a jere yadda Gaon zai iya bi?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta lissafin da za ka yi idan ka saka 20?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi ko sakamakon daidai yake da 14 ko ya bambanta?
z-m-01-08.s.s3.model.0: Saka 20 a madadin □, sannan ka lissafta 20+6. 26 ne, ba 14 ba. Saboda haka 20 ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.model.1: Mu saka 20. 20+6=26 ne, wanda ya bambanta da 14, saboda haka ba daidai ba ne. Idan ka saka wata lamba, 8, to 8+6=14, saboda haka ita daidai ce.
z-m-01-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta bincika lambar da ba daidai ba sannan ta gwada amsar daidai ma.

z-m-01-04.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da ke da kuskure a mafita.
z-m-01-04.title: Shin '=' yana nufin kullum a rubuta amsa?
z-m-01-04.goal: Nemo rashin fahimtar cewa '=' alama ce kawai ta rubuta amsa a cikin mafita da aka yi, sannan yanke hukunci ko jumlolin lissafi gaskiya ne ko ƙarya bisa ma'anar cewa ɓangarorin biyu suna da adadi iri ɗaya.
z-m-01-04.material: Jiho ya warware matsala domin nemo lambar da za ta shiga □ a 3+4=□+2. Duba mafitar Jiho layi-layi sannan ka yi tunanin abin da '=' yake nunawa. ('3+4' ana karantawa 'uku ƙari huɗu', □ kuma 'akwati'.)
z-m-01-04.thinking.2: Lissafa kowane gefe dabam sannan a kwatanta
z-m-01-04.prereq.0: Kwarewar lissafi mai sauƙi da lambobi har zuwa 10
z-m-01-04.s.s1.prompt: Jiho ya nemo lambar da ke cikin □ a 3+4=□+2 kamar haka. Zaɓi layi ɗaya da yake da wuya a yarda da shi.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta kowane layi da baki sannan ka duba ko yana biyo ta halitta daga layin baya.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: A jumlar lissafi ta layi na 3, lissafa gefen hagu 3+4 da na dama 7+2 dabam, sannan ka kwatanta su.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.line.1: Bayan = ana rubuta sakamakon lissafi, saboda haka rubuta 7 a □.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.line.3: Don haka □=7, kuma hakan daidai ne.
z-m-01-04.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 shi ne matsala ta farko. '=' ba kullum yake nufin cewa sakamako yana bayansa ba; yana nufin gefen hagu da na dama suna da adadi iri ɗaya. Idan aka lissafa jumlar lissafin layi na 3, gefen hagu 7 ne, dama kuma 7+2=9 ne, saboda haka ba su yi daidai ba. Don haka ƙarshe a layi na 4 ma yana da wuya a yarda da shi. Abin da za ka gani ya danganta da layin da ka zaɓa. Layi na 1 an lissafa shi daidai.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.prompt: Menene ma'anar '='? Zaɓi amsar da ta fi dacewa.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.hint.0: Karanta 3+4=7 da 7=3+4 da baki dabam-dabam sannan ka duba ko duka suna da ma'ana.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.hint.1: Idan akwai abubuwa 3+4 a gefe ɗaya na ma'auni da abubuwa □+2 a ɗayan, kuma ma'aunin ya daidaita, faɗi irin dangantakar da ke tsakanin su.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.o.a: Alama ce ta rubuta amsa a dama
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.a: Wannan tunani yana ganin '=' a matsayin wuri ne kawai na rubuta amsa. Yana da wuya a bayyana jumlolin lissafi da aka rubuta kamar 7=3+4.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.o.b: Alama ce ta fara lissafa gefen hagu
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.b: Wannan tunani yana ganin '=' a matsayin umarnin lissafi. Ba ya ganin alama ce ta kwatanta ko ɓangarorin biyu iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.o.c: Gefen hagu da na dama suna da adadi iri ɗaya
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunani yana ganin ta a matsayin alama cewa ɓangarorin biyu suna da adadi iri ɗaya.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.o.d: Lambar hagu ta fi lambar dama girma
z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.d: Wannan tunani ba ya bambance 'iri ɗaya' da 'mafi girma'. Ana nuna 'mafi girma' da wata alama daban.
z-m-01-04.s.s2.explain: '=' yana nufin ɓangarorin biyu suna da adadi iri ɗaya. Saboda haka a 3+4=□+2, dole ne a sa □+2 ya yi daidai da 3+4.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi duk jumlolin lissafi na gaskiya a ƙasa.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.hint.0: Lissafa gefen hagu da na dama na kowace jumlar lissafi dabam, sannan ka rubuta.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.hint.1: Idan gefen biyu iri ɗaya ne, jumlar lissafi gaskiya ce. Idan ba su yi daidai ba, faɗi wanne gefe ya fi girma.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.a: Ko da lissafi yana gefen dama na '=', ma'anar 'iri ɗaya' ba ta canzawa.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.b: Hagu 7 ne, dama kuma 8, saboda haka ba su yi daidai ba. Wannan bai bincika ma'anar '=' a matsayin adadi iri ɗaya ba.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.c: Dukkan ɓangarorin 7 ne. Ko da akwai lissafi a ɓangarorin biyu, za ka iya kwatanta ko sun yi daidai.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.r.d: Wataƙila wannan tunani ya duba ƙarin da aka yi wa lambar hagu a lissafin dama sannan ya yanke cewa sun yi daidai. Dole ne a lissafa ɓangarorin biyu dabam sannan a kwatanta.
z-m-01-04.s.s3.explain: 7=3+4 gaskiya ce domin ɓangarorin biyu 7 ne; 6+1=5+2 ma gaskiya ce domin ɓangarorin biyu 7 ne. 3+4=7+1 yana da 7 da 8, 3+4=4+4 ma yana da 7 da 8, saboda haka ba gaskiya ba ne.

z-m-01-05.title: Ya fi kusanci da 40 ko 50?
z-m-01-05.topic: Nemo goma mafi kusa cikin lambobi har zuwa 100
z-m-01-05.goal: Kwatanta kusanci ta adadin matakai a layin lamba, koyi yanayin da ba za a iya cewa wanne ya fi kusa ba, sannan ka ƙirƙiri lambobi da suka cika sharuɗɗan da kanka.
z-m-01-05.material: Ka yi tunanin 40, 41, 42, ..., 60 a jere a layin lamba tare da mataki ɗaya tsakanin su. Muna kwatanta kusancin lambobi biyu bisa adadin matakan da ke tsakaninsu a layin lamba. Matakai kaɗan suna nufin sun fi kusa. A wannan karon, yi la'akari da natural numbers kawai.
z-m-01-05.thinking.1: Koyo game da yanayin da ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba
z-m-01-05.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar lambobi da yawa da suka cika sharuɗɗa
z-m-01-05.prereq.0: Jeri da kwatanta girman lambobi har zuwa 100 (matakin aji na 1)
z-m-01-05.s.s1.prompt: A layin lamba, 40, 41, 42, ..., 50 suna jere da mataki ɗaya tsakaninsu. 47 ya fi kusa da 40 ko 50?
z-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙirga matakai nawa ne daga 47 zuwa dama har 50.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga kuma matakai nawa ne daga 47 zuwa hagu har 40, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya ƙirga sannan ya kwatanta matakan daga 47 zuwa kowane gefe.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.r.b: Wataƙila tunani ne cewa goma ta farko ta fi kusa. Ba a ƙirga matakan da 47 yake nesa da kowace ba.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.o.c: Ya yi kusa da biyun daidai
z-m-01-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani bai kwatanta adadin matakai zuwa wuraren biyun ba, kawai ya ɗauka yana wani wuri a tsakiya.
z-m-01-05.s.s1.explain: Daga 47 zuwa 50 matakai 3 ne, zuwa 40 kuma 7 ne. Gefen da matakansa suka fi kaɗan shi ne mafi kusa.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙirga matakan daga 45 zuwa hagu zuwa 40 da dama zuwa 50, kowannensu dabam.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta adadin matakan biyun gefe da gefe sannan ka kwatanta wanne ya fi.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.o.a: Ya fi kusa da 50, domin mun amince a zagaye sama idan akwai 5
z-m-01-05.s.s2.r.a: Yarjejeniya ta bambanta da kusanci. Ba dalili ba ne bisa ƙirga da kwatanta matakai.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.o.b: Matakai 5 ne daga 40 kuma matakai 5 ne daga 50, saboda haka babu gefe mafi kusa
z-m-01-05.s.s2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya ƙirga matakan zuwa ɓangarorin biyu sannan ya kwatanta.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.o.c: Ya fi kusa da 40, domin 4 yana zuwa kafin 5
z-m-01-05.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya yanke hukunci bisa lambar da ta fara ko ta zo daga baya kawai. Ba a ƙirga matakan daga 45 zuwa kowane gefe ba.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.explain: Daga 45 zuwa 40 matakai 5 ne, zuwa 50 ma matakai 5 ne, saboda haka ba za ka iya yanke wanne ya fi kusa ba. A irin wannan yanayi, muna buƙatar yarjejeniya kan inda za a aika shi.
z-m-01-05.s.s2.acc.0: Idan ka bi yarjejeniyar 'zagaye sama idan akwai 5', za ka iya cewa 50. Amma wannan yarjejeniya ce da muka yi, ba don 45 ya fi kusa da 50 ba. Ya fi kyau ma a fara cewa yana da tazara iri ɗaya da biyun.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta lambobi daban-daban 3 da suka fi 40 ƙanana da 60, kuma suka fi kusa da 50 fiye da 40 ko 60.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi ɗan takara guda ta kwatanta matakan da yake nesa da 50 da waɗanda yake nesa da 40 da 60.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo wanne daga 40 da 60 ɗan takaranka yake da matakai iri ɗaya da shi, sannan ka cire wannan lambar.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.ok.c1: Lamba ce mafi girma da 40 amma ƙarama da 60.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Rubuta natural number da ya fi 40 amma bai kai 60 ba.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.ok.c2: Ya fi kusa da 50 fiye da 40.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Ya fi kusa da 40 fiye da 50, ko kuma tazararsu daidai ce.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.ok.c3: Ya fi kusa da 50 fiye da 60.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Ya fi kusa da 60 fiye da 50, ko kuma tazararsu daidai ce.
z-m-01-05.s.s3.explain: Dukkan lambobi daga 46 zuwa 54 sun cika sharuɗɗan. 45 da 55 suna da kusanci iri ɗaya da goma ɗaya, saboda haka ba su cika sharadin 'mafi kusa' ba.
